title: OUCHI POD - Meet&Date Wellbeing Partner
tagline: OUCHI POD is an application that creates encounters with a focus on Wellbeing.
description: OUCHI POD is an application that creates encounters with a focus on wellbeing. The app aims to help people make new connections, reduce stress and loneliness and promote mental health and well-being.OUCHI POD connects interrelated people based on geographical location, interests and lifestyle. Through the app, users can find new friends and mentors online. OUCHI POD also facilitates real-life encounters and allows users to participate in communities and events. ouchipod aims to promote healthy social connections, so privacy and security are taken into consideration.
how_its_made:
OUCHI POD is an application that creates encounters focused on wellbeing and involves users from all over the world. The application uses World ID, Gnosis and Safe for greater security. Users can access the application from anywhere in the world and use the gnosis chain for secure transactions.

The greatest attention has been paid to security and privacy in this application. Users can make new connections in a safe and private environment, promoting mental health and well-being.
